register_name: Audit of the committed results and price file (data/raw/games.csv)
method: Read-only. Nothing in the source file was changed. Values are copied or computed here; comparisons are against official NFL pages read on 2026-11-14.

coverage.opening_price_note: The file has no opening-price column. Every price column is a single closing value, so a store that records both the opening and the closing number cannot be built from this file alone.

convention.how_it_was_established: Correlated the result column against the spread column over every row where both are present. A positive correlation means the two share a sign, so the spread column is stated from the home club's perspective.
convention.statement: result = home_score - away_score, total = home_score + away_score, and spread_line is the closing line from the home club's perspective (positive means the home club was favoured by that many points).

current_season_completeness.statement: Every one of the 16 most recent games the file carries a price for is missing its result, including the 2026-11-12 Thursday-night game the league published two days before this review.

club_reconciliation.description: For each club, the season record and points are recomputed from the committed file and compared with the official standings read on 2026-11-14. A club can only be reconciled if none of its games is missing a result.

officially_verified_outcomes.description: Outcomes the league publishes for games this session read. Each is compared with what the committed file holds for the same game id.

reconciliation_after_official_ingest.description: The per-club reconciliation of section 4 repeated with the sixteen officially read outcomes applied to the games the committed file leaves blank. Every club is now checkable, so this is a direct test of the transcription: a single wrong score would break two clubs at once.
reconciliation_after_official_ingest.statement: 32 of 32 clubs reconcile exactly on W-L-T, points for and points against once the official outcomes are applied, against 2 of 32 before.

market_vs_outcome_2026.description: Closing price against actual outcome for every 2026 game the file has a result for. 'model_fair_line' is deliberately left blank: no model in this repository has been fitted and validated, so printing a fair line would be fabrication, and the difference column that depends on it is left blank with it.
market_vs_outcome_2026.interpretation_note: These are descriptive measurements of how far the closing price finished from the result. They are not a strategy, not an edge, and not a claim that anyone could have beaten the number, because the closing price is not a price anyone could have taken.
